stories.title: George Russell's Season of Disasters — "I've Never Had a Year Like This"

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Russell won Australia. He drives for championship-leading Mercedes.

He's 59 points behind his own team-mate.

Anti-stall failure. Engine DNF. Mechanical after mechanical.

"I've never had a season like this."

Coulthard: "Beyond a Rocky story." 😤

#F1 #GeorgeRussell

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
George Russell's 2026 disasters:

❌ China — technical failure
❌ Japan — safety car timing
❌ Monaco — penalty
❌ Canada — engine DNF while leading
❌ Belgium — power unit issue
❌ Hungary — anti-stall at Turn 1

Same car as the championship leader. 59 points behind. 😤

#F1

stories.title: FIA Admits It Saw the 2026 Power Unit Problems Coming — And Why It Couldn't Act

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The FIA knew 2026 power units would cause chaos.

They just didn't have manufacturer backing to change anything.

FIA's Tombazis: "a shame."

350kW MGU-K. No DRS. 50/50 ICE-electric split.

Verstappen called it "Formula E on steroids."

He wasn't wrong. ⚡
